#             literal/expression evaluated through Leia for comparison, or
#             ERROR / ERROR:substr when canonical q signals an error, or NAN
#   leia      deviation entries: the DOCUMENTED Leia behavior (expression,
#             ERROR:substr, or NAN); optional drift pin for gap entries.
#   reason    free text for deviation/gap entries.
# Every canonical column was hand-encoded from canonical kdb+/q semantics;
# entries the author was not certain about were left out rather than guessed.
